name: northstar
description: Northstar — real-time maritime GNSS position-trust platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @northstar/contracts && npm run build -w @northstar/core && npm run build -w @northstar/server && npm run build -w @northstar/web && npm run build -w @northstar/device-sim
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @northstar/contracts && npm run build -w @northstar/core && concurrently -n server,web,device,osnma -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @northstar/server" "npm run dev -w @northstar/web" "npm run dev -w @northstar/device-sim" "npm run osnma"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @northstar/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @northstar/core && npm run typecheck -w @northstar/server && npm run typecheck -w @northstar/web && npm run typecheck -w @northstar/device-sim
